items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Rex Steele was in that band -- so I heard this kind of music in my summer vacations in Detroit

ctx.x: So Horace Henderson had a really great band in those days, and Benny Carter, right out of school, want too, in Ohio, they formed this great band, and Rex Steele was in that band -- so I heard this kind of music in my summer vacations in Detroit, and when I go back to Alabama to school, they would -- that impression was just so strong, see. So that was really why Detroit was the town I settled in, and joined the union, tried to start a career after I had left school.
